IEAGHG (2013). Iron and Steel CCS Study (Techno-Economics Integrated Steel Mill). Report 2013/04, July 2013. IEA Greenhouse Gas R&D Programme, Cheltenham, UK. Synthesis report "Understanding the Economics of Deploying CO2 Capture Technology in an Integrated Steel Mill" (Vols. I-III); prepared with Swerea MEFOS (lead), Tata Steel Consulting (cost model) and SINTEF Materials and Chemistry (capture modelling); IEAGHG project manager not named in the text layer. No DOI printed.

Targeted pass over 642 pages. LOADED (main): (a) whole-mill results per t HRC for the REFERENCE BF-BOF mill (Case 1), MEA post-combustion EOP-L1 (2A) and EOP-L2 (2B), OBF with MDEA/Pz (Case 3) and CHP step-offs 3A/3B: coking coal, PCI and NG input, direct CO2, captured CO2, % avoided, avoidance cost, total investment and specific capex, fixed/variable/total O&M, HRC breakeven price, life, discount rate; (b) unit-level rows derived per own product from the per-t-HRC tables using the study ratios (0.9922 thm, 0.4076 t coke, 1.1114 t sinter, 0.0866 t lime, 1.0526 t slab, 1.0808 t liquid steel per t HRC): coke ovens, sinter strand, reference BF, OBF, BOF, ladle metallurgy, caster, reheating furnace, hot strip mill, PFR lime kiln, HP and LP ASUs, captive power plant options (base, 1A, 1C, 1D, NGCC), steam boilers; unit capex is total installed cost per unit (excl. contingency and shared site/BOP), opex-fixed = unit maintenance + direct labour; (c) host-side capture rows (stoves, steam boiler, coke ovens, lime kilns) and capture units (MEA L1, L2, MDEA/Pz) per t CO2; (d) ULCOS capture-option energy (Vol. III Table C-1, reprinted). Flows: per-unit material inputs/outputs. NOT LOADED: full mass balances, gas compositions, raw-material prices, cash-flow annex, per-unit O&M cost tables, Vol. I cases 1B (needs reheating-furnace WHB), sensitivity figures (read from chart). LOCATOR: printed page labels with volume (Overview p.N; Vol. I/II/III p.X-N) plus the PDF page in brackets. PRICE YEAR: US$ 2010 stated (Vol. I Sect. E-2.9). Heating values: gases LHV (Table C-11); solid fuel basis not stated.

(1) Vol. II Tables C-1/C-2 print reboiler steam as "MJ/t CO2 captured" (3.03, 3.18): must be GJ/t. (2) Table 5 totals include 4.00 kg/t HRC transport fuel while Table 9 direct emissions do not (2094.14 vs 2090.14); % avoided 50.1/60.3 (Table 5) vs 50.2/60.4 (Table 9). (3) Case 3B direct CO2 1092.2 (text) vs 1091.2 (Table E-1); avoidance cost 51.7/47.9 (text) vs 51.9/47.7 (Figure E-6). (4) Vol. III Table D-5 labels Unit 3000 as HP O2 (it is the LP ASU). (5) Power plant net efficiency 32.1% (Vol. I) vs 32.2% (Vols. II-III). (6) Vol. I Table F-9: Cases 1C/1D totals equal 1B despite different power plant and flare rows. (7) Vol. II Introduction lists Unit 300 as oxy-blast furnaces for the post-combustion case (copy error). (8) Overview text says capture plant handles ~860 t CO2/t HRC (should be kg).
